goal: Service worker review: cached responses, update flow and scope.
use: Service worker review: cached responses, update flow and scope. Use when a service worker is added or changed.

steps.note: Read the registration. Check the scope and the script location.
Check caching. Flag caching of private or authenticated responses.
Check updates. Confirm a new version takes over without leaving users on stale code.
Check failure. The offline fallback must not hide errors.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
